EZconn.why: EZconn supplies high-density fiber interconnects for hyperscaler AI data centers and is developing silicon-photonic CPO-ELS modules for GPU scale-up; AI optical buildout drives its revenue.
EZconn.evidence: EZconn investor conference deck (03-13-2026): AI infrastructure - scale-out high-density fiber deployment for hyperscaler data centers; scale-up active silicon photonic CPO-ELS modules for GPUs (expected 2026).

players.product: Optical active and passive components: high-density fiber interconnects for AI data-center scale-out (up to 6,912-core torpedo cables), CPO external-laser-source (ELS) modules for scale-up (expected 2026), FTTH optical engines and high-frequency RF connectors
